Dengue fever transmission and primary symptoms

Dengue fever is primarily transmitted through the bite of an infected *Aedes* mosquito, though rare transmission can occur via blood transfusions, organ transplants, or needlestick injuries. Primary symptoms typically appear 3 to 14 days after infection and include high fever, headache, vomiting, muscle and joint pains, and a characteristic skin rash.
